Wind erosion not modelled (RUSLE is water-only); in SW Kansas wind erosion can dominate on bare soil.
Single soil bucket with slope-dependent storm runoff; water use is irrigation need, not metered pumping.

Ogallala aquifer saturated thickness / well capacity and water-right limits (Kansas WIMAS) not considered.
Soil index is a simplified NRCS Soil Conditioning Index proxy including root and crown biomass.

FIN-060.name: Alfalfa (3 yr)–corn (2 yr) (full irrigation)
FIN-060.description: Perennial forage builds soil; needs hay market and more labour.
FIN-060.why_considered: Introduces deep-rooted perennial legume to fix atmospheric nitrogen and supply high-demand Southwest Kansas dairy and beef forage markets.
benefits: Breaks monoculture pest and weed cycles by adding broadleaf/legume to grass rotation
Biological N fixation in 3 of 5 yr cuts synthetic fertilizer
~51% less water erosion than current rotation (1.30 t/ha/yr p50)
